system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 4. 4 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (22 seconds, code score 0.90) ---
[b00] THE PRIEST (booming): "...husband and wife!"
[b01] SFX: Dramatic musical chord swelling.
[b02] GERALD (furious, shouting): "You have thrown yourself away!"
[b03] GERALD (livid): "For a penniless nobody!"
[b04] JULIANA (calm, cutting): "I would rather choose my own life..."
[b05] JULIANA (firm, final): "...than spend another moment begging for yours."
[b06] ACTION: Gerald recoils slightly, mouth agape.
[b07] LADY ASHCROFT (imperious, shouting): "Do not bring this man anywhere near Ashcroft Manor!"
[b08] LADY ASHCROFT (venomous): "You are disowned!"

--- WINDOW 1 (27 seconds, code score 0.76) ---
[b00] JULIANA (unwavering): "I am."
[b01] THE PRIEST (resigned, solemn): "Then... let us proceed."
[b02] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (low, reassuring): "You need not say anything you do not mean."
[b03] JULIANA (warm, sincere): "I truly mean it."
[b04] ACTION: The Mysterious Bearded Man carefully slides the band onto Juliana's finger.
[b05] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (solemn): "You have my protection."
[b06] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (steadfast): "You have my respect."
[b07] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (grave): "And you have my word."
[b08] THE PRIEST (ceremonial): "By the authority entrusted to me, I now pronounce you..."
[b09] THE PRIEST (booming): "...husband and wife!"
[b10] SFX: Dramatic musical chord swelling.
[b11] GERALD (furious, shouting): "You have thrown yourself away!"

--- WINDOW 2 (39 seconds, code score 0.73) ---
[b00] JULIANA (conflicted, pained): "You heard what they think I am."
[b01] JULIANA (searching): "Why would you offer me your name?"
[b02] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (grave, certain): "Because I know what I see."
[b03] JULIANA (quiet, hesitant): "And what do you see?"
[b04] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (firm, sincere): "A woman who was betrayed."
[b05] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (resolute): "Not a woman who deserves to be discarded."
[b06] JULIANA (soft, bitter): "You don't know what my family has done to me."
[b07] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (solemn): "I know they have made you stand alone."
[b08] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (gentle): "You don't have to stand alone now."
[b09] JULIANA (defiant, dignified): "If this is pity, take back your ring."
[b10] JULIANA (fierce): "I will not become anyone's charity."
[b11] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (earnest): "It is not pity, Lady Juliana."

--- WINDOW 3 (22 seconds, code score 0.71) ---
[b00] LADY ASHCROFT (imperious, shouting): "Do not bring this man anywhere near Ashcroft Manor!"
[b01] LADY ASHCROFT (venomous): "You are disowned!"
[b02] MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (soft, protective): "Come, Lady Juliana."
[b03] ACTION: Clarissa gapes in shock while Lady Ashcroft exhales in exasperation.
[b04] SFX: Heavy oak doors creaking open, followed by a triumphant musical swell fading out into silence.
[b05] ACTION: Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man walk hand-in-hand through the towering doors into the sunlight together, turning their backs on the ruined wedding as the screen fades out.

Pick the single best promo.
